lead.claim: Try multimodal non-fatiguing recovery for better neuromuscular restoration.
lead.context: *Why this matters*: A study compared multimodal non-fatiguing recovery to passive and active recovery for football players after a match.

supporting.claim: Supervised exercise and CBT may help post-COVID-19 patients.
supporting.context: A systematic review explored the effectiveness of various interventions for post-COVID-19 condition, focusing on cardiorespiratory fitness, walking capacity, and fatigue.

supporting.claim: Describe the mechanical dose of tendinopathy exercises, not just the label.
supporting.context: This commentary suggests that detailed documentation of load, effort, and patient response for tendinopathy exercises improves clinical reasoning and reporting.

supporting.claim: A new module helps characterize communication diversity in autistic adults.
supporting.context: Researchers developed and validated a 10-item Communication Characteristics module and a five-level Communication Profile variable for autistic adults.

supporting.claim: Multifactorial interventions and exercise can reduce falls in older adults in LMICs.
supporting.context: An integrative review explored fall prevention interventions, including exercise and home modifications, among older adults in low- and middle-income countries.
